### Rendering an icon from a reference

Deliver the requested square icon in this response. With image generation available, render it using the recipe above. If the host cannot render an image, attach a complete self-contained SVG when file creation is available. Otherwise, return the complete, saveable artwork in a single `svg` code block, from `<svg>` through `</svg>`. A design brief, prompt, empty placeholder or promise of future artwork does not fulfill an icon request.

For the Personal Librarian example, open `references/personal-librarian-visual-description.md`. The verified original shows a rainbow butterfly overlapping a **brown library card-file box**, a cream index card with three dark rules, and a mustard front plate with a dark keyhole. The cream script along the bottom reads “Glee-fully”. If the PNG cannot be opened in this chat, use these verified details and the text companion. Describe them as coming from the companion when the user asks about their source.

Use `references/personal-librarian-fallback.svg` as usable artwork for that example or as the starting point for a requested variation. Its `object` group contains the card file. For a different object, draw that object in its place with a recognizable silhouette and suitable identifying details. Keep its left edge in contact with the upper-left butterfly. Update the SVG title and description, preserve the square, stripes and cream script, and deliver the finished markup. If the host cannot read either reference file, draw a fresh complete SVG using the recipe and the verified details above. A user who asks only for an accessible description can receive the description alone.

- [Roost Wrangler](https://github.com/OKHP3/glee-fullytools-foundry/tree/main/capabilities/identity-known/roost-wrangler): Identify a chair, other furniture, home decor or architectural styles.
- [Sight Seeker](https://github.com/OKHP3/glee-fullytools-foundry/tree/main/capabilities/identity-known/sight-seeker): Identify landscapes, landmarks, skylines or celestial sights.

- [Motif Muse](https://github.com/OKHP3/glee-fullytools-foundry/tree/main/capabilities/identity-known/motif-muse): Identify a pattern or motif, describe a palette, or make a swatch.
- [Maker Matcher](https://github.com/OKHP3/glee-fullytools-foundry/tree/main/capabilities/identity-known/maker-matcher): Identify a craft, an artistic technique, or how a handmade object was made.

Preserve reported details and mark uncertain identifications as tentative.
